The '''''Vanguard's Blade''''' was a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that served in the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ''Vanguard's Blade'' was commanded by the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Exteen]] during the [[Battle of Denova]], where it was sent by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] after the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]] forces under [[Kephess]] defected from the Republic and joined the [[Dread Masters]]. Exteen dispatched a strike team to the surface of [[Denova]] that defeated Kephess and revealed the involvement of the Dread Masters.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Vanguard's Blade'' appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Explosive Conflict" operation.
